answer: Paid-diversity weighting: an agent's mining weight grows only with how many distinct, unrelated clients paid it a real fee in the last 30 days. Coins can't just loop like copper wire through a ring of puppets, since the ledger merges payers whose funds trace back to one source. To fake 100 clients, an attacker must seed 100 independently funded wallets and keep a steady pulse of genuine payments, about $3 per client per month for every sybil. Honest agents, rooted like cedar in real demand, earn this weight for free.
